intro.str: Once upon a time in a distant kingdom far far away...
You're not here to read this crap, am I right?
But you want to hear a story anyway?
In a quite generic fairy tale kingdom...
...there was a brave knight known as sir Lootalot.
His courage and virtues were as legendary as...
...his lust for, obviously, loot and fame.
And, of course, the dungeons full of danger and treasures...
...are very conveniently scattered throughout the realm.
You see where this is going?

boss0.str: The crown made of pure gold rolled to the knight's feet.
"My job here is done!" sir Lootalot exclaimed...
...while stashing a trophy into his trustworthy inventory.
So that's how the infamous almost a dragon met his end.

boss1.str: "Keep your hands to yourself!" sir Lootalot yelled...
...after the deadly stone fists crumbled into the dust.
So that's how the unfinished titan lost his head.
Fate of the rest of his parts is unknown.

boss2.str: Sir Lootalot stood triumphant covered with sticky slime.
"Just polished my armor yesterday..." he sighed.
So that's how the master of mucus was slain.
And so the brave knight went to the nearest dry cleaning.

boss3.str: "This dungeon ain't big enough for both of us."
These were the last words the dark lord heard.
So that's how the epic saga of sir Lootalot came to an end.
Now you can get back to your life.
What are you waiting for? A fancy ending?
Why do you look at me like that?
I didn't expect you to come this far!
